meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 把 Slack 适配器、注册测试和格式化技能复制进项目,注册适配器并安装固定版本依赖,跑构建和注册测试;再引导你创建 Slack 应用、把令牌存进 .env 并重启服务,之后可在 Slack 频道或私信收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Slack 频道时触发。若你在 /setup 流程中,它在该流程内执行;否则完成后可用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 完成接线。

say.text: 帮我接入 Slack 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并引导你建 Slack 应用。

say.text: 用 Webhook 方式接入 Slack
say.note: 需公网 HTTPS 能访问 /webhook/slack。

howto.what_en: Copies the Slack adapter, its test and formatting skill into the project, registers it, installs the pinned dep, builds and runs the test. Then it guides creating a Slack app, saves tokens to .env and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack channel integration. It runs inside /setup if you are there; otherwise wire the channel with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Slack channel integration to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, guides app creation.

say_en.text: Set up Slack with Socket Mode (no public URL needed)
say_en.note: Adapter picks Socket Mode when SLACK_APP_TOKEN is set.

say_en.text: Set up Slack with webhook delivery
say_en.note: Needs a public HTTPS URL serving /webhook/slack.
